scenario.description: Phase 4: all 16 turrets in sandbox2 (hard) on Lyne. A Targeter near the spawn (uid 1) joins a far Blue, a Red and the Sniper; a Fusion fed by a Green and a Yellow; a Combonly plate with a maxed Red and Yellow locks in the tazer rocket at tick 200; a Railgun near the base; the Sniper; all seven modifiers; upgrades, a move that unjoins the Blue, a sale. A wave every 3 s.
